national-revival.name: Isaak Brodsky
national-revival.note: Born at Sofiivka in the Berdiansk area, he later founded the Berdiansk art museum.

national-revival.name: Pyotr Schmidt
national-revival.note: Son of the head of Berdiansk port, he led the 1905 Black Sea Fleet mutiny.

ukrainian-revolution.name: Nestor Makhno
ukrainian-revolution.note: Returned to Huliaipole in 1917 and built the insurgent movement there.

ukrainian-revolution.name: Maria Nikiforova
ukrainian-revolution.note: Native of Oleksandrivsk, she helped seize the city in the Aleksandrovsk uprising of December 1917.

ukrainian-revolution.name: Fedir Shchus
ukrainian-revolution.note: Regrouped with Makhno in the Huliaipole district and fought at Dibrivka.

soviet-takeover.name: Volin
soviet-takeover.note: Moved his Nabat group to Huliaipole and chaired the Makhnovist military council in 1919.

soviet-takeover.name: Pyotr Wrangel
soviet-takeover.note: Led the offensive into Northern Taurida in 1920.

soviet-takeover.name: Semen Karetnyk
soviet-takeover.note: Born in Huliaipole in 1893 and died in November 1920.

soviet-takeover.name: Halyna Kuzmenko
soviet-takeover.note: Taught in Huliaipole, where she married Makhno.

soviet-ukraine-1920s.name: Alexander Vinter
soviet-ukraine-1920s.note: Headed the Dneprostroi project from 1927 to 1932.

soviet-ukraine-1920s.name: Hugh L. Cooper
soviet-ukraine-1920s.note: Served as a consultant on the Dnieper hydroelectric project.

soviet-ukraine-1920s.name: B. B. Janz
soviet-ukraine-1920s.note: Molotschna-born minister who helped thousands of Mennonites emigrate to Canada before leaving in 1926.

holodomor-terror.name: Polina Osipenko
holodomor-terror.note: Born in Novospasivka near Berdiansk, she set Soviet flying records in the 1930s.

holodomor-terror.name: Alexander Dovzhenko
holodomor-terror.note: His film Ivan portrayed a Dniprobud construction worker and industrialization.

soviet-annexations.name: Oleksandr Ivchenko
soviet-annexations.note: Tokmak-born engineer who worked in Zaporizhzhia's aircraft-engine industry.

soviet-annexations.name: Sergey Tumansky
soviet-annexations.note: Worked at aircraft-engine Plant No. 29 in Zaporizhzhia around 1938-1940.

nazi-occupation.name: Erich von Manstein
nazi-occupation.note: Had Army Group South's headquarters at Zaporizhzhia, where Hitler visited him in 1943.

postwar-ussr.name: Leonid Brezhnev
postwar-ussr.note: Led the Zaporizhzhia regional party in 1946-1947 during reconstruction.

postwar-ussr.name: Oleksandr Ivchenko
postwar-ussr.note: Led the Zaporizhzhia engine design bureau from 1945.

soviet-ukraine-late.name: Vyacheslav Bohuslayev
soviet-ukraine-late.note: Became director general of the Zaporizhzhia engine-building works in 1988.

soviet-ukraine-late.name: Oleksandr Ivchenko
soviet-ukraine-late.note: Led the Zaporizhzhia design bureau until his death in the city in 1968.

orange-to-euromaidan.name: Oleksandr Peklushenko
orange-to-euromaidan.note: Governed Zaporizhzhia Oblast from November 2011 to March 2014.

crimea-donbas-war.name: Hryhoriy Samardak
crimea-donbas-war.note: Governor in 2015, then chairman of the oblast council to 2020.

full-scale-invasion.name: Ivan Fedorov
full-scale-invasion.note: Abducted by Russian troops in March 2022 after refusing to cooperate.

full-scale-invasion.name: Yevgeny Balitsky
full-scale-invasion.note: Leads the Russian occupation authorities in the oblast.

full-scale-invasion.name: Oleksandr Starukh
full-scale-invasion.note: Headed Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia administration in the first phase of the invasion.

full-scale-invasion.name: Rafael Grossi
full-scale-invasion.note: Led the IAEA team to the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant in 2022.

war-of-attrition.name: Ivan Popov
war-of-attrition.note: Commanded Russian troops in the Zaporizhzhia sector in 2023.

war-of-attrition.name: Oleksandr Tarnavskyi
war-of-attrition.note: Took part in the 2023 breakthrough that freed Robotyne.

war-2025-2026.name: Ivan Fedorov
war-2025-2026.note: Has led Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia administration since February 2024.

war-2025-2026.name: Yevgeny Balitsky
war-2025-2026.note: Heads the Russian occupation authorities in the oblast.
